Large Takeout filesread once, never truncated
A decade of YouTube history can be 50–200 MB in one watch-history.json. Mirror reads one file at a time and refuses a file over 67 million characters (64 MiB) instead of cutting it short.If yours is larger, Mirror says so and asks you to request a shorter date range or split the archive. It will not import part of a file and call the rest empty.
A partial import would make a quiet week look quiet. That is the one failure this screen exists to prevent.

What this file is

Rendered by packages/ui/mockups/render.mjs from the real components in packages/ui/screens through the DOM binding, with the generated token CSS inlined. It is not a drawing of the screen.

What to check

An "empty" frame is rendered for a persona that lacks a tier this screen needs, so it shows the real degraded state: what Mirror says when it cannot measure something.

Reproduce

npm run tokens && npm run mockups
